title: Frontend: Notification item actions — mark read, snooze, dismiss
description: Build the individual notification item with action buttons for mark read, snooze, and project link.
acceptanceCriteria: Each notification shows: type icon, message text, project name (if applicable), time ago
Unread notifications have a blue dot indicator
Click on notification marks it as read
Snooze button opens a time picker (1 hour, 3 hours, tomorrow, custom date)
Clicking notification with project navigates to that project

steps.details: Create src/components/notifications/NotificationItem.tsx. Show: type icon (Bell for system, Calendar for due dates, Trophy for milestones), message, project name link, time ago. Blue dot if !is_read. On click: PATCH /read, navigate to project if projectId.
Three-dot menu on each notification. Options: 'Snooze 1 hour', 'Snooze 3 hours', 'Snooze until tomorrow'. Each calls PATCH /snooze with the appropriate datetime. Custom snooze: date picker.
Click a notification — verify marked read, unread count decreases. Snooze one — verify it disappears. Navigate to project from notification.
